CMOS switched-capacitor half divider
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VIN vin 0 PWL(0 3.3 40u 3.3 40.01u 2.8 120u 2.8)
VP1 p1 0 PULSE(0 3.3 20n 1n 1n 430n 1u)
VP2 p2 0 PULSE(0 3.3 520n 1n 1n 430n 1u)
XDUT vdd 0 vin out p1 p2 astra_035_cmos_switched_capacitor_half_divider
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec half33 range 1.61 1.69 unit=V
* @spec ripple33 range 0 0.015 unit=V
* @spec half28 range 1.36 1.44 unit=V
* @spec ripple28 range 0 0.015 unit=V
* @spec final range 1.36 1.44 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 2n 120u
meas tran half33 AVG v(out) FROM=25u TO=35u
meas tran ripple33 PP v(out) FROM=25u TO=35u
meas tran half28 AVG v(out) FROM=85u TO=95u
meas tran ripple28 PP v(out) FROM=85u TO=95u
meas tran final FIND v(out) AT=119u
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
